claim: The Codex CLI adds a marketplace from a folder that has only .claude-plugin/marketplace.json (it reads the plugin entry's string source "./", the marketplace's own folder, as a local source, with install policy AVAILABLE and auth policy ON_INSTALL), and when the folder also has .agents/plugins/marketplace.json it takes that file instead. It reads a plugin's .claude-plugin/plugin.json when that is its only manifest, and takes .codex-plugin/plugin.json when both are there. `codex plugin add` copies the plugin into $CODEX_HOME/plugins/cache/<marketplace>/<plugin>/<version>/ and enables it in $CODEX_HOME/config.toml; the model is shown each skill as <plugin>:<skill> from that copy. An edit to the source reaches the model only after `codex plugin add` is run again.
how: node observations/codex/plugin-marketplace-and-manifest.probe.mjs (beside this record). It copies this repository's .claude-plugin/marketplace.json and two manifests into scratch folders with one probe skill, varying which manifests and marketplace files are there and their versions, and runs `codex plugin marketplace add`, `codex plugin list` (with --json --available), `codex plugin add` and `codex debug prompt-input hello` (the model-visible input, which lists the skills) with a throwaway CODEX_HOME each. No command calls a model. Scratch paths are written <scratch>.
recheckWhen: Codex is upgraded, or the marketplace or a manifest changes shape.
